patches.name: log_arena_address
patches.evidence: Exact 01.36 ELF SHA90880b52: single MOVABS R14 initializes global +0x1e5f658, passed to checked FIXED MapNamedDirectMemory(size64KiB, name dbg::GameLog) and used by memset/Boot logger header. Original 0xfaaaa00000 is beyond Odin3 39-bit user VA; 0xfaaaa0000 is below the game PRT aperture start0x1000000000 and inside production owned envelope. No mapped pointer is rewritten; the game still allocates and maps the real backing. All other registers and flags unchanged. Candidate requires clean-session runtime validation.
